neighbours.label: the title word of a named industry survey, index or analyst report (Survey, Index, Quadrant)
fire: The figures come from the annual State of DevOps Survey published last week.
Python climbed to first place in the latest TIOBE Index of languages.
Analysts placed the vendor in the leaders corner of the new Forrester Wave report.
Results from the Global Workforce Survey suggest remote work is here to stay.
The company was named a leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for data integration.
According to the Edelman Trust Barometer, faith in business rose slightly.
Data from the Global Gender Gap Index show slow progress in politics.
The JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey covered more than twenty thousand coders.
quiet: Before the fence went up, the farmer asked a crew to survey the boundary.
Check the index at the back of the book for every mention of rivers.
The northern quadrant of the park is closed for tree work this month.
She did a quick survey of the fridge and decided to order pizza.
The surgeon examined the upper left quadrant of the abdomen.
Each chapter ends with a short index of the plants it describes.
The barometer in the hallway showed that a storm was coming.
From the hilltop the scouts could survey the whole valley below.
